title: Paused presentation change (veil removal + edge chip) has zero automated coverage; achievable headless geometry pin skipped
detail: The diff's only behavior change has no automated pin: app/ has zero @(test) procs and the chip is inline in main(). A future refactor could re-add the veil or re-center text (reopening ruling-grade issue #48) with every suite green — violating the project rule 'Everything testable headless, is.'
recommended_fix: Extract the chip layout into a pure proc (e.g. paused_chip_rect(win_w) -> rl.Rectangle, cf. tray_chip_rect in app/render/tray.odin:40) and pin with @(test): position/size and non-overlap vs health (win_w/2+230) and forecast (win_w-250) edges at 1280.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
_pr_body.md (diff hunk): '**No app-level overlay test was
   added: the harness captures never include the app overlay** (the overlay
   is app-layer-only, drawn in `main.odin`, deliberately outside the
   harness capture path — the golden-stability contract) — so there is no
   harness surface to pin the chip position; the existing pause goldens
   remain the sim-level pins.' — claim verified TRUE against harness/goldens.odin:59-66. Existing pins verified present: core/pause_test.odin:52-53: '@(test)
test_pause_freeze_resume_replay :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {' plus demos/pause.dem ('at 60500ms pause / at 70000ms resume / capture at 65000ms / capture at 80000ms') with goldens/pause.t1, goldens/pause/65000ms.png, goldens/pause/80000ms.png, goldens/pause.log.bin; 25 demos in demos/; no core/harness/goldens/data files in the diff (git diff v2 --stat: app/main.odin + 3 planning docs + _pr_body.md only).
detail: P0 sim-pause pins 100% (freeze/resume/replay/mid-pause edits — pause_test.odin + pause.dem T1/T2/replay, untouched by this diff); functional P1 covered by existing suite. The diff's own behavioral delta (2 presentation behaviors) is 0% automated — manual visual verification only. Not FAIL: presentation is deliberately outside the golden contract and the sim spine is fully pinned.
recommended_fix: Land the paused_chip_rect @(test) pin from the coverage finding — raises the gate to PASS (P0 100%, P1 >=90%, presentation delta pinned headless without touching the harness golden contract).
